datacenter_info.description: The account's datacenter as the catalog names it.

available.description: It can be changed now: the account is active, its panel can, and the change is free or has a price.

free.description: No successful change yet: the next one is free. Every later one is charged price.

price.description: Core's price of a paid change (SKU hosting.domain_change.<region>, term once); null when none.

id.description: Region-unique: the datacenter's 3-digit prefix and a 9-digit sequence.

identity_hold.description: The account is locked until the account owner verifies their identity: suspended on its server, and every operation but reading it and keeping it paid (auto-renew, renew) refused with identity_hold (403). Billing is unchanged; a renewed account stays suspended until the identity is verified, when it is released.

ip_address.description: The address the control panel assigned the account (where its domain's A record points). Cached: set at creation, refreshed by GET /accounts/{id} and the inventory sweep. Null while pending, once terminated, or until the panel has reported it.

kind.description: Its plan's kind when ordered; never changes (a plan change stays within it).

reset_incomplete.description: A reset removed the account from its server and has not created it again yet: true while a reset runs, and after one that failed halfway (its action ends with reset_incomplete). Run the reset again to recreate it.

command.description: reseller_account_*: a reseller's operation on one of its customer accounts, on the reseller's account; result names it (username, domain, package, reason).

data.description: The kind's details. attack_blocked: {domain, ip, requests, window_s, block_s}; disk_threshold: {percent (70 or 90), used_mb, limit_mb}; over_quota: {stage (warning, suspended or cleared), used_mb, limit_mb, grace_ends_at (unix seconds, warning only)}; resource_limit: {cpu, memory, entry_processes, processes, io, iops} - how often each CloudLinux limit was hit in the latest hour.

kind.description: attack_blocked, disk_threshold, over_quota or resource_limit (others may be added).

Capabilities.description: What the account's control panel can do. Anything off is refused with feature_unavailable.

account_password.description: The account's own password (control panel login, FTP, SSH) can be changed: POST /accounts/{id}/password.

change_domain.description: The account's main domain can be changed in place: POST /accounts/{id}/domain.

cloudlinux.description: The account's server runs CloudLinux OS (detected, not configured): GET /accounts/{id}/cloudlinux, /resource-usage and /php. Never for a reseller.

dns.description: The zone can be read and edited here.

login_targets.description: One-time login links this panel can mint for the account; reseller (the reseller level: WHM, DirectAdmin's reseller panel) only for a reseller account.

panel.description: Which control panel this is (cpanel, directadmin), for a client to name it (WHM, DirectAdmin). Null on a datacenter whose servers run different panels.

redis.description: A per-account Redis can be run: /accounts/{id}/redis.

reseller.description: Reseller accounts can be created and managed on this panel.

reseller_accounts.description: Only on a reseller's account: it can create, delete, reset, re-package, suspend and unsuspend its own customer accounts, set their passwords and log into them (login_targets panel, file_manager, webmail as listed): /accounts/{id}/reseller/accounts.

reseller_privileges.description: The reseller privileges this panel can withhold; a reseller here always holds the others.

reset.description: The account can be reset to a freshly created one: POST /accounts/{id}/actions/reset. Never for a reseller.

shell.description: Shell access can be read and switched: /accounts/{id}/shell. A shell is only ever given confined (CageFS, or the panel's jail).

ssh_keys.description: SSH public keys can be managed: /accounts/{id}/ssh-keys.

standalone_database_users.description: A user can exist without a database; when false, create a user by granting it a database with a password.

traffic.description: Download traffic is metered against the plan's quota: /accounts/{id}/traffic.

CloudLinuxStatus.description: Isolation and the limits in force (cloudlinux-limits). The PHP Selector's state is GET /accounts/{id}/php's.

cagefs.description: The account's CageFS cage: its own filesystem view, other accounts invisible. unavailable: the server's CageFS is not initialized.

cagefs_ready.description: CageFS is initialized on the server.

limits.description: CloudLinux (LVE) limits. 0 is unlimited; null not reported.

symlink_protection.description: The server's link-traversal protection (CloudLinux LinkSafe) is on.

id.description: Identifies the record to update or delete; may change after any edit, so re-read the zone.

EndOfTerm.description: What happens if the current term ends unrenewed. Present for an active account whether auto-renew is on or off, and for one suspended for a lapsed term; null when nothing is scheduled (pending, terminated, or suspended for abuse or by staff). Each step can come up to the renewal interval (minutes) after its time.

deletes_at.description: When the account and all its data are deleted: suspends_at plus the region's retention. RFC 3339 time, UTC.

retention_days.description: Days a lapsed account is kept suspended before deletion.

suspends_at.description: When the account is suspended if its current term is not renewed (auto-renew off, or the renewal refused): the term's end. For an account already suspended for a lapsed term, when it was suspended. RFC 3339 time, UTC.

error.description: English, for people. Branch on code.

current.description: Selected version; native is the server's own PHP.

native_version.description: The server's own PHP version behind native, e.g. 8.3.

enabled.description: Offered by the server; a disabled version cannot be chosen.

editable.description: Settable here: bool and list options, and a few numeric ones.

value.description: The account's setting; null: the default applies.

cpu_cores.description: CPU cores the plan states. Null: not stated. Enforced as the CloudLinux CPU limit (100% a core) where the server runs CloudLinux.

features.description: Short English keys (e.g. free_ssl, unlimited_ftp, unlimited_traffic) for the client to localize; at most 20, never null.

kind.description: shared: one hosting account. reseller: an account that creates and sells hosting accounts of its own.

memory_mb.description: Memory the plan states, in MB. Null: not stated. Enforced as the CloudLinux memory limit where the server runs CloudLinux.

reseller.description: A reseller plan's terms; null for a shared plan. limits.disk_mb and limits.bandwidth_mb are then the reseller's totals over every account it owns.

dedicated_ip.description: Created on its own IP address instead of the server's shared one.

max_accounts.description: Accounts the reseller may create. Null: no cap.

overselling.description: May allocate more disk and bandwidth to its accounts than the plan's totals.

privileges.description: What the reseller may do beyond managing its accounts.

resources.description: CloudLinux limits the plan sets beyond memory and CPU. Null: the server's default; 0: unlimited.

entry_processes.description: Concurrent web and cron entries (CloudLinux EP).

sku.description: Accounting SKU: hosting.plan.<code>.<term>, or hosting.reseller.<code>.<term> for a reseller plan.

Redis.description: A per-account Redis: run as the account's user inside its CageFS, unix socket in its home only (no TCP), password, maxmemory from the tier with allkeys-lru eviction, no persistence.

password.description: Only for a holder of hosting:redis:manage.

paid_tier.description: The tier the current term is paid for.

due_now.description: Estimated charge to move to this tier now (prorated for the rest of the term; display only).

price.description: Per term; renews with the account.

created_at.description: When the panel created it; null when the panel does not say. RFC 3339 time, UTC.

domain_change.description: Changing the customer account's main domain; a paid change is charged to the reseller's account.

free.description: No change of this account's domain from here yet: the next one is free.

price.description: Core's price of a paid change (SKU hosting.domain_change.<region>, term once); null when none.

package.description: The package the reseller put it on.

accounts.description: Its customer accounts on this package.

name.description: As the panel names it (WHM: <reseller>_<name>); a customer account's package carries the same name.

used.description: Accounts the reseller created (its own not counted).

used_mb.description: Over every account it owns, this month.

overselling.description: Its plan lets it sell its customers more disk and bandwidth than its totals.

faults.description: How often each limit was hit.

limits.description: CloudLinux (LVE) limits. 0 is unlimited; null not reported.

points.description: Averages per interval over the whole window, oldest first (lve-stats); an interval the account was idle in is zero.

faults.description: How often each limit was hit.

contained.description: The shell is confined: CageFS or the panel's jail.

ssh_port.description: The SSH port the control panel reports.

Snapshot.description: How fresh a CloudLinux answer is: these are answered from a snapshot at once and refreshed in the background (one CloudLinux call at a time per server).

loading.description: Only on 202: never read before and not ready yet; no data. Ask again in a few seconds.

refreshing.description: A read of the server is under way; ask again (or ?refresh=1) for its answer.

stale.description: Older than a few minutes: a new read is running.

Traffic.description: An account's download traffic in its current traffic period (one month anchored on its term's start). Only download (HTTP bytes sent to visitors) counts against the plan's quota; upload is free and shown for information. Download above the quota is charged per GB while overage_billing is on; while it is off the account's sites are blocked (HTTP 509) once the quota is reached, until the next period. MB are 2^20 bytes, GB 1024 MB.

billed_gb.description: Overage already charged this period: whole GB while the period runs, the remainder when it closes.

blocked.description: The account's sites answer the traffic quota exhausted page (HTTP 509).

can_manage.description: The caller holds hosting:traffic:manage on the account.

daily.description: Per day (the server's Asia/Tehran date), oldest first.

download_mb.description: Downloaded this period, as last read (3 decimals).

estimated_overage_rial.description: overage_mb at price_per_gb, rounded (display only: accounting rates the charge); null when the price is unknown.

overage_billing.description: On: overage is charged to the wallet. Off: the sites are blocked when the quota is reached.

price_per_gb.description: Price of one GB of overage in the region's currency (core's catalog); null when unknown.

read_at.description: When the server was last read.

Usage.description: For a reseller, disk and bandwidth are its totals over every account it owns and accounts is set; null for a hosting account.

used.description: Accounts the reseller created (its own not counted).

session.description: A session from POST /auth/exchange with core's handoff assertion.

info.description: Shared web hosting (cPanel/WHM, DirectAdmin) in one region. Every region serves the same API at its own base URL; ids are unique across regions. Long operations answer 202 with an action to poll. Errors carry a stable `code`. Requests are rate limited per caller (RateLimit-* headers, 429 rate_limit_exceeded).
